identity.title: Show truthful alignment stage and state in the Studio header

origin.summary: The shared-project analysis identified an obsolete alignment-status message, and current-build Wide and Compact evidence confirmed it.

state.current_summary: The Studio header now reports the most downstream present A3/A2/A1/legacy step and its actual State; state changes refresh the presentation without executing product actions, and focused, build, Wide/Compact UI, and refreshed R0 checks pass.

claims.text: The Studio header can report a legacy alignment scaffold even when an A3 Re-grid Height Map step exists and exposes a different current state.

problem.impact: Operators receive a false progress statement about a core A1/A2/A3 workflow and cannot trust the header as a current-stage summary.

criteria.text: The header reports the most downstream present alignment stage in A3, A2, A1, legacy order together with that step's current state.
A step State change refreshes AlignmentStatusSummary without invoking Preview, Publish, Run, or another product action.
The existing Tool Recipe teaching verifier and solution build pass with the new status regression coverage.
Fresh current-build Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 before/after application-only evidence demonstrates the corrected header and acceptable capture quality.

context.summary: The header binding is StudioHeaderView.AlignmentStatusText -> Workbench.AlignmentStatusSummary.
This issue does not change alignment algorithms, Preview/Publish/Run contracts, theme resources, or layout topology.

artifacts.summary: Current-build Wide and Compact before/after screenshots, screenshot-quality reports, monitor/window placement records, and verification output.

evidence.observation: Current Release Wide and Compact captures show a selected Re-grid Height Map step in Waiting for upstream state while the header reports the legacy affine scaffold message; both screenshot quality reports accepted the captures on the dynamic leftmost monitor.

Release Tool Recipe teaching verification passed 35/35, including no-stage, legacy, A1, A2, A3 precedence, exactly one status notification after an A3 State change, and zero Preview/Publish/Run log actions.
Debug and Release solution builds completed with zero warnings and errors; the existing CI-routed verifier passed in both configurations, and git diff --check passed.

Application-only Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 before/after captures passed quality checks and changed the false legacy summary to 'A3 Re-grid Height Map | Waiting for upstream'; both actual Release windows intersected dynamic leftmost DISPLAY2, and refreshed nine-input R0 ValidateOnly passed in both layouts without launching the application.

events.summary: Registered the confirmed status-reporting defect and started the bounded correction.
Replaced the obsolete message with actual downstream stage/state projection, added state-change notification and no-action regression coverage, and passed build, UI, and fixed-input gates.
